disclaimer.title: Welcome to the Luxosa Test
disclaimer.intro: In just a few minutes, it will help us better understand your hair, your scalp, your habits and your needs, so that we can offer you a first personalised orientation.
disclaimer.howText: It is a simple multiple-choice test: for each question, select the options offered. Some allow a single answer and move on automatically; others allow up to two, to be confirmed with “{{continue}}”. You can always go back and change your choices.
disclaimer.importantText: The Luxosa Test offers a preliminary orientation and does not constitute a medical, trichological or dermatological diagnosis. The professional assessment takes place in Maison.
